g.text: Synthetic 24 × 24-pixel radar-like chips (gamma sea clutter; ships = bright elongated blobs). In the biased training set a bright quay strip on the
left edge accompanies 95 % of ships. Numpy MLP 576-64-1 (ReLU), 60 Adam epochs on 6 000 chips; saliency averaged over ship chips of the uncorrelated
